checkpoint.source_to_compact_evidence: Runner recorded a model tensor digest of the atomically pinned full checkpoint and compared it with a newly loaded compact checkpoint before unlinking the source inode. This verifier independently recomputes the retained compact model digest.
checkpoint.boundary: The original full pinned inode was unlinked after publication. The verifier independently validates the retained compact checkpoint against the source-model digest recorded at freeze; it does not reopen the original pinned source or substitute the changing trainer last.pt.

official_RICH_grid.independent_sample_warning: Stride-64 windows have up to 128 of 192 frames in common. Window count is not an independent recording count; clean/noisy are paired predictions, not extra windows.

source_array_scope: Published source metadata SHA and declared per-array/input hashes checked; large raw arrays were not rehashed or rebuilt. Saved GT is the reference for independent CPU metric recomputation.
scope: All persisted official RICH development VAL ego-grid windows; overlapping windows, not an independent TEST or an assumed external-paper benchmark protocol. No model forward, no CUDA, no training update.
